scope: Simulation engineering and illustrative operational risk assessment, not a clinical deployment safety case.
status: Proposed ordinal engineering judgments; team review/sign-off pending. Scores are not measured probabilities and do not establish certification.
scale: S/O/D each 1-10. Higher severity, occurrence and poorer detection increase RPN. Severity is held unchanged; code existence alone does not prove an occurrence reduction.

modes.name: Payload slips during lift or carry
modes.effect: Object remains uncleared, rework and possible equipment impact.
modes.mitigation: Modest retained grip force, lift clearance, held-load checks and bounded recovery. Residual O remains nonzero; few development seeds do not establish a failure rate.
modes.evidence: src/controller.py: grip_force, s_nav_drop, dropped; tests/test_controller_reliability.py: lower-pressure carry regression; audited pilot reports zero carry drops.

modes.name: Arm/payload contacts furniture or robot base
modes.effect: Interrupted mission and potential equipment damage in the simulated task.
modes.mitigation: Check approach/drop clearances and payload height, preserve safe navigation turns, record contacts every physics step. Collision counting is detection, not proof of avoidance or an emergency-stop certification.
modes.evidence: src/grasp.py: candidates; src/sorting.py: plan_drop; tools/experiment_core.py: ContactAudit; payload/base contact regression.

modes.name: No safe delivery pose or blocked receptacle
modes.effect: Item cannot be delivered; staff intervention and delayed room readiness.
modes.mitigation: Try alternative receiving points, account for occupied zones, bound retries and retain the payload in SAFE_STOP if no safe route is available.
modes.evidence: src/controller.py: drop_fail; src/sorting.py: plan_drop; tests/test_controller_reliability.py: failed delivery retains payload, occupied shallow tray test.

modes.name: Misplacement is incorrectly reported as success
modes.effect: False room-clear status and uncompleted sorting work.
modes.mitigation: Check full object bounds, floor/rim and post-withdrawal placement. Independent final evaluation checks destinations against known simulator types. That final check uses simulator state and is not a real-world classifier safeguard.
modes.evidence: src/controller.py: check_withdrawal; tools/experiment_core.py: evaluate; tests/test_controller_reliability.py: footprint and misplaced-item tests.

modes.name: Room arrivals exceed service capacity
modes.effect: Growing queue; no finite steady-state waiting-time prediction.
modes.mitigation: Expose utilisation and reject finite M/M/c predictions when rho >= 1. Occurrence is unchanged until staffing/capacity is actually altered; no automatic service improvement is claimed.
modes.evidence: analytics/hospital_business.py: queue_mmc; queue stability and zero-arrival unit tests.
